text.p: The Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale said on Monday it recommended a "buy" for shares in German's prestige camera maker Leica Camera AG, which was first floated a month ago.

WestLB said it was raising its Leica earnings per share (EPS) forecast for the year to March 1998 by 10 percent to a total of 3.10 marks after the "greenshoe" option, or overallotment option, is stripped out.

WestLB said it was recommending the stock because the company's new "R8" camera had been well-received by both trade and press and because the new Leica scanner had received advance orders well in excess of expectations.
The bank said it was increasing its 1997 sales forecast for Leica by five percent to 309 million marks.
